q: HTTP status code 404 ka matlab kya hai?
explain: 404 Not Found matlab client ne jo resource maanga wo server par hai hi nahi. Ye 4xx (client error) class mein aata hai.

q: DNS normal query ke liye kaun sa protocol aur port use hota hai?
explain: Normal DNS queries UDP port 53 par hoti hain (fast aur chhoti). Zone transfer aur bade responses ke liye TCP 53 use hota hai.

q: DHCP ke DORA process mein steps kaun se hain?
explain: DORA = Discover (client broadcast), Offer (server IP offer), Request (client chuna hua IP maangta), Acknowledge (server confirm).

q: HTTP status 401 aur 403 mein kya farak hai?
options: 401 = login nahi hai; 403 = login hai par permission nahi
explain: 401 Unauthorized matlab authentication missing (aap login hi nahi ho). 403 Forbidden matlab login to hai par is resource ki permission nahi.

q: In mein se kaun sa HTTP method idempotent NAHI hai?
explain: POST idempotent nahi hai: baar-baar bhejne par naye records ban sakte hain. GET, PUT, DELETE idempotent hain, repeat karne par result nahi badalta.
